key_stair.name: Julie's Other Key
key_stair.description: Opens the stair under the School. Small and bright, on a loop of garden twine. The label is in the hand of the letter: LOCKED, AND KEPT LOCKED. NOT FOR HIM. The back of it is written on too, under the twine.

key_school.name: School Door Key
key_school.description: Opens the front doors from outside. On a loop of string with the coal tally. The label says FRONT DOORS, and under it, CARETAKER ONLY. They've been bolted from inside for a long time.

key_tower.name: Tower Key
key_tower.description: Opens the tower. One key off a ring of forty. The fob says TOWER, and under it, in the same hand, DO NOT LEND.
